evaluation: expanded custom development regression; not a new independent issue or official benchmark
instruction: Fix reliable copying of cookies in prepared requests. A standard-library CookieJar has no copy method, so PreparedRequest.copy fails. Copies and RequestsCookieJar.update must also avoid sharing mutable Cookie objects with the source. Preserve cookie domains, paths, values and unrelated prepared-request behavior. Inspect the repository and implement a compatible fix. Only existing Python files under requests/ will be exported. No network is available. You may write local tests; do not modify upstream tests. Submit after focused checks pass. Preserve all Cookie flags and metadata when copying or updating, and preserve the type and configured policy of standard CookieJar subclasses. A subclass may require constructor arguments. Do not reset configured state.
